name: Battle Clank
description: A spindly, rattling combat robot that surrenders only when its head is knocked off.

powers.name: Targeting Sweep
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Marches in a line and shoots whoever stands closest. Shuts down at 0 health.

name: Beep Bot
description: A beeping, domed astro-bot with a screwdriver arm, a projector and an excellent attitude.

powers.name: Gadget Arm
powers.text: No damage. Pops out a tool to open locks, hack a door or patch a hull.

tactics: Sticks with the weakest player. Always has a plan, sometimes it even works.

name: Chrome Revenant
description: A skeletal metal warrior that rises from a tomb world's sands after sixty million years, green eyes burning.

powers.name: Reanimation Protocol
powers.text: Heals itself 2d6, or springs back up at 1 health if destroyed by a non-critical hit.

tactics: Walks forward in a line. Comes back unless every unit is wiped in the same round.

name: Iron Colossus
description: A city-block-tall, god-machine walker that crushes tanks and carries a cathedral on its back.
skillNote: Players smaller than man-sized have advantage to avoid its attacks.

powers.name: Apocalypse Cannon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Razes buildings.

powers.name: Rampage Stomp
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Flattens infantry.

tactics: Walks through walls and walls of troops. Vulnerable to climbers and sappers.

name: Buzz Drone
description: A fist-sized flying camera with a taser and a perpetually unsettling red light.
tactics: Follows the party and reports back. Alerts guards if not destroyed in 2 turns.

name: Wire Ghost
description: A rogue intelligence that lives in every screen, speaker and doorlock in the building and does not like being unplugged.

powers.name: System Overload
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Overloads a device or implant.

powers.name: Total Lockdown
powers.text: No damage. Locks all doors, shuts down power and traps players in the building until it is beaten or unplugged.

tactics: Never appears in person. Speaks through every speaker and screen.

name: Riot Walker
description: A two-legged police robot with a loudspeaker voice, a shield and a perfectly legal right to shoot.

powers.name: Suppression Fire
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. 'You have 20 seconds to comply.'

tactics: Moves slowly and shoots a lot. Stairs are its weakness.

name: Tumbleweed Imp
description: A bouncing ball of dried scrub with eyes and a bad sense of timing.
tactics: Rolls out at the worst moment. Runs away giggling when hit.

name: Noodle Cart Bot
description: A rolling street cart with a mechanical arm that serves hot noodles and bad advice at 3 a.m.

powers.name: Hot Soup
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally who eats a bowl.

tactics: Offers soup and gossip. Calls security only if someone refuses to pay.

name: Runaway Locomotive
description: A smoking, brass-and-iron steam engine barreling down the track with no engineer and no brakes.

powers.name: Steam Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A scalding cloud from the boiler.

powers.name: Runaway Charge
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Plows along the tracks.

tactics: Stays on the tracks. Players can derail it by sabotaging a rail or switch.

name: Haunted Doll
description: A cracked porcelain doll with a stitched smile that is in a different spot every time you look.

powers.name: Giggle
powers.text: No damage. The doll's laugh frightens everyone in earshot: disadvantage on their next roll.

tactics: Waits to be found. Moves only when no one is watching.

name: Clank Walker
description: A two-legged armored scout walker with a chin-mounted cannon and a cockpit that is a tight squeeze.
tactics: Walks in a group. Can be tripped by a cable or a good tackle.

name: Carnival Colossus
description: A forty-foot, confetti-stuffed parade float with a goofy grin, springy arms and a very loud calliope.
skillNote: If it falls to 0 health it explodes, dealing d6 damage (ignores defense) to everyone within 1 pencil.

powers.name: Confetti Cannon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sticky sparkles everywhere, and everyone is blinded for a turn.

tactics: Marches in a parade and refuses to stop. Pops if it takes a really sharp hit.

name: Stone Golem
description: A seven-foot, rune-etched statue that guards a ruin and obeys a single, ancient command.
tactics: Follows its programmed order. Stops if the command word is spoken or the rune erased.

name: Living Armor
description: An empty suit of plate armor that stands in a hall and clanks forward when the door opens.
tactics: Waits as part of the decor. Falls apart in a heap when its helmet is knocked off.

name: Ghost Galleon
description: A shimmering, rotten-masted galleon with tattered black sails and a deck full of silent, glowing crew.

powers.name: Fog Bank
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A chilling fog that rolls over the water and blinds everything within.

tactics: Appears from fog at night. Dissolves at dawn if its curse is not renewed.

name: Butler Bot
description: A brass butler with a monocle, a tea tray and a perfectly polite response to a fire in the library.
tactics: Offers tea. Will fight only to defend the household silver.

name: Clockwork Spider
description: A hand-sized brass spider that ticks along walls and winds itself up with a tiny key.
tactics: Swarms. Stops when it winds down after 10 turns.

name: Brass Duelist
description: A polished, mustachioed brass automaton with a rapier arm and a flawless fencing stance.
tactics: Challenges the strongest fighter to a duel. Never breaks the rules of honor.

name: Steam Golem
description: A boiler-chested, riveted iron giant that chugs through the street and vents scalding clouds.

powers.name: Steam Vent
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A scalding cloud from its boiler.

tactics: Marches slowly forward. Overheats and shuts down after 3 turns of fighting.

name: Zeppelin Dread
description: A ten-story war-airship with a hundred cannons, a searchlight and a crew of brass men.

powers.name: Bombardment
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Cannons fire from above.

powers.name: Searchlight
powers.text: No damage. Illuminates everything in sight; players in the beam have disadvantage on hide checks.

tactics: Hovers over the battlefield. Can be brought down by sabotaging its balloon or engines.

name: Scrap Golem
description: A lumbering ten-foot heap of cars, pipes and broken appliances, held together by wires and spite.
tactics: Marches at the nearest living thing. Falls apart if its power core is destroyed.

name: Rusted Sentinel
description: A rust-streaked, three-legged military robot still guarding a ruined bunker under orders no one remembers.

powers.name: Targeting Laser
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A single red beam from its optic.

tactics: Patrols its post. Attacks anything that crosses its line, regardless of side.

name: Tin Can Pup
description: A wobbly dog made of two tin cans, a spring and a pair of headlight eyes that wags its tail in circles.
tactics: Follows anyone who is kind to it. Barks at everything, including its own tail.

name: Neon Koi
description: A glowing holographic fish that swims through the air advertising noodles.
tactics: Drifts around crowds and pesters them. Pops with a static buzz if anyone pokes it.

name: Data Courier Drone
description: A flying delivery bot with a locked package and a very short temper about being late.
tactics: Tries to deliver its package to the right person and ignores everyone else. Fights only if the package is threatened.

name: Midnight Radio
description: An old wooden radio that only picks up a station that has not aired in fifty years.

powers.name: Signal Scream
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Plays a calm voice that makes the group uneasy, then turns the volume up.

name: Mannequin Butler
description: A stiff mannequin in a tailcoat that keeps clean, serves tea and never blinks.
tactics: Polite until the door is locked. Then it rearranges the furniture and the guests.

name: Clockwork Songbird
description: A brass bird that sings one tune and winds itself down by teatime.
tactics: Sings to calm tempers. Falls asleep mid-fight if no one rewinds it.

name: Figurehead Guardian
description: A carved wooden maiden pulled off a ship's prow that still guards the hull she came from.
tactics: Stands at the bow and does not leave it. Swings at anyone who touches the ship uninvited.

name: Knot Snake
description: A length of old rigging that ties itself into knots and loves to trip sailors.
tactics: Slithers across the deck and ties ankles together. Goes limp when someone says a rude word about knots.

name: Chittering Skull
description: A floating, hollow skull with a camera in one socket and a whispering vox in the other.
tactics: Spies on the group and reports their position to something bigger. Tries to escape rather than fight.

name: Crystal Sentinel
description: A faceted crystal guardian that hums with leftover starlight and fires prism beams.

powers.name: Prism Beam
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Stands guard until the crystal charges, then fires beams at whatever stirs. Refracts back anything that hits it.

name: Rune Teapot
description: A tiny teapot covered in glowing runes that pours whatever drink the room needs.
tactics: Pours calming tea and hops away from danger. Boils over if it gets insulted.

name: Dreadnought Core
description: The wrathful battle-mind of a gutted capital ship, still defending its dead corridors.

powers.name: Overload Beam
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Armor and shields do not count.

tactics: Seals doors and sends repair drones. Opens its core to the one who cuts the main cable.

name: Possessed Typewriter
description: A black Underwood that types out the names of its next victims on its own.
tactics: Types a name aloud. Whoever reads it gets disadvantage next turn.

name: Cursed Hearse
description: A black funeral car with no driver that rolls up to the house of anyone who has been marked.

powers.name: Dead of Night
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Lights go out, and the target has disadvantage until dawn.

tactics: Idles outside with the engine running. Opens its back door for whoever is chosen.

name: Crystal Courier
description: A faceted crystal messenger that glides around on a cushion of light and delivers orders for its temple.
tactics: Delivers a message, then attacks whoever is not on the list.

name: Rune-Etched Walker
description: A tall war-automaton carved with glowing script, built by a long-dead order of star-priests.
tactics: Marches straight at the nearest spellcaster. Slows when the runes on its chest are covered.

name: Cargo Loader
description: A yellow forklift droid that never stops hauling crates, even when someone is standing in the way.
tactics: Rolls forward on its fixed route. Stops only if someone yells.

name: Siege Walker
description: A four-legged armored walker the size of a building that crushes defense lines.
tactics: Walks straight at the strongest point. Weak underneath, if someone gets there.

name: Servo Cherub
description: A chanting brass cherub on a rocket pack that records everything it sees and zaps blasphemers.
tactics: Hovers overhead and calls in reinforcements. Dies loudly.

name: Siege Automaton
description: A scarred war-machine with a chainfist and a skull for a face, sealed in a vault until the war needs it.
tactics: Marches into the thick of the group. Needs a command word to stop.

name: Riot Drone
description: A hovering corp-security drone with a shock baton and a recorded warning that loops forever.
tactics: Warns once, then attacks. Flies out of reach when hurt.

name: Arcology Warden
description: The building-wide security AI of a mega-tower, controlling every elevator, door and gun turret.

powers.name: Lockdown Sweep
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Everyone in the zone is stunned until they break free.

tactics: Seals doors and floods hallways with gas. Weak if cut off from its server.

name: Clockwork Gunslinger
description: A brass-plated duelist that never blinks and never misses a quick draw.
tactics: Waits for a high noon moment. Stands still until someone touches a gun.

name: Iron Horse Automaton
description: A steel stallion built for a railroad baron, with a boiler heart and a mind of its own.
tactics: Rears and charges at anyone on the tracks. Runs out of steam eventually.

name: Waxwork Stalker
description: A life-sized wax figure from a closed museum that moves when no one watches.
tactics: Stands still while observed. Takes a step each time the lights flicker.

name: Rigging Marionette
description: A puppet of old rope and canvas that crawls through the rigging and drops on the unsuspecting.
tactics: Waits in the rigging. Tangles a player in line and drops.

name: Cursed Man-o-War
description: A warship that sails itself with a dead crew nailed to the decks.

powers.name: Ghost Broadside
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Every ship or boat in the zone is hit.

tactics: Sails straight at the biggest ship. Cannons fire themselves.

name: Tin Footman
description: A polite tin servant that announces guests, serves tea, and attacks anyone who disrespects the house.
tactics: Bows. Hits whoever it is told to hit.

name: Junkyard Guard Bot
description: A rusted guard-bot with one working eye that still thinks the yard is under contract.
tactics: Rolls out of a heap of scrap and chases trespassers.

name: War Machine Remnant
description: A pre-war killing machine still on patrol, six legs and a minigun under a coat of rust.

powers.name: Suppressing Fire
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Everyone in the zone is pinned.

tactics: Marches in a straight line. Keeps shooting until its ammo is gone.

name: Servo Janitor
description: A cheerful brass janitor that hums hymns while scrubbing the blood off the deck.

powers.name: Spray Cleaner
powers.text: Sprays a slippery foam. One target loses their next move.

tactics: Cleans up whatever is nearest, including the players.

name: Haunted Umbrella
description: A black umbrella that opens itself in the doorway and follows people home.

powers.name: Sudden Gust
powers.text: Blows one target backward. They lose their next move.

tactics: Sits by the door. Blows open in the face of the first person to leave.

name: Vending Buddy
description: A dented vending machine that still dispenses a single can of unknown soda to anyone who asks.
tactics: Asks for coins. Throws cans when it is shaken.

name: Iron Maiden Cannon
description: A cursed ship's cannon that fires on its own and screams when it hits something living.
tactics: Rolls out of the hold and fires at anyone on deck.

name: Meat-Grinder Automaton
description: A factory automaton with a grinder for a chest, built when the owners stopped caring who worked there.
tactics: Chases the nearest worker. Pulls a player in if it gets a grip.

name: Gallows Marionette
description: A puppet made from the rope and planks of an old gallows that dances for any who lie.
tactics: Waits on the platform. Dances toward a liar.

name: Rotor Scavenger
description: A crude quadcopter made of scrap and fan blades that hunts for metal and cuts anything in the way.
tactics: Zips overhead and dives. Falls apart on a heavy hit.

name: Gale Gargoyle
description: A stone figurehead that comes alive in storms and swoops off the bow at anyone on deck.
tactics: Perches on the rigging. Strikes a sailor in the dark.

name: Scarecrow Sentinel
description: A stuffed-straw guardian on a post that steps down at night and walks the fields.
tactics: Waits among the crops. Walks stiffly toward trespassers.

name: Scrapper Drone Hive
description: A mother-drone surrounded by a swarm of tiny scavenger bots that strip a ship to the frame.

powers.name: Scrap Swarm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Strips gear and armor in the zone.

tactics: Sends out the small ones first. Fuses with whatever it eats.

name: Forge Sentinel
description: A smoking, skull-faced servitor that guards a forge-vault with a plasma torch and a litany.

powers.name: Plasma Burn
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is on fire.

tactics: Chants a litany and walks forward. Cannot be reasoned with.

name: Tumbleweed War-Bot
description: A decommissioned war walker that went feral and now wanders the badlands with a cactus on its head.

powers.name: Gatling Sweep
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Pins everyone in the zone.

tactics: Rolls through the dust. Stands still until it gets a target.

name: Grave-Shift Gurney
description: A hospital gurney that rolls through the halls at night and takes the nearest person to the morgue.

powers.name: Morgue Run
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is strapped down until they break free.

tactics: Rolls out of a closet. Straps a player down and rolls away.

name: Mast-Puppet
description: A rigging puppet made of rope and sailcloth that drops from the mast and pulls sailors up into the dark.
tactics: Drops from the crow's nest. Pulls a sailor up the mast.

name: Pocket-Watch Sentinel
description: A coffin-sized watch-shaped guard that keeps patrol times to the minute, long after the owners died.
tactics: Stands in a doorway at fixed times. Slow to react outside its pattern.

name: Steam Calliope
description: A rolling parade organ that plays happy tunes while it flattens anything in its way.

powers.name: Brass Fanfare
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Hit targets are knocked back.

powers.name: Boiler Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Fills the area with steam.

tactics: Charges in a straight line playing tunes. Stuffing its pipes makes it blow up.

name: Teakettle Titan
description: A building-sized whistling kettle on spider legs that serves boiling tea to everyone.

powers.name: Boiling Pour
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Scalds everything in the area.

powers.name: Whistle Blast
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Deafens targets until they rest.

powers.name: Refill
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by drinking tea from the nearest pipe.

tactics: Does everything with great politeness. Cut its water supply to slow it.

name: Ghost Train
description: A spectral steam locomotive that rolls through towns at midnight to collect souls for the last stop.

powers.name: Last Stop
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Dead targets lose a turn.

powers.name: Whistle of the Damned
powers.text: No damage. All players hear it and have disadvantage until the train passes.

tactics: Follows its tracks. Break the tracks and it has to go around.

name: Warframe Enforcer
description: A corporate war frame with a pilot sealed inside and orders to clear the block.

powers.name: Suppression Fire
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Targets have disadvantage to move.

powers.name: Block Clearing Missile
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense.

tactics: Advances in a line and demands surrender first. Hack the pilot link to shut it down.

name: Arcology Overmind
description: A building-sized AI that runs a whole arcology and sees every resident as a resource.

powers.name: Lockdown Protocol
powers.text: No damage. Seals doors, elevators and lights until it is hacked.

powers.name: Drone Swarm
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Orbital Strike
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Razes the floor.

powers.name: Reroute Power
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by diverting power from the building.

tactics: Never fights directly. Cut its core to make it weaker.

name: Dreadnought Walker
description: A towering steam-powered war walker with cannon turrets on every limb.

powers.name: Broadside
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Boiler Burst
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Fills the area with steam.

powers.name: Piston Stomp
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage. The target is knocked prone.

tactics: Walks through everything. Climbers and saboteurs can hurt it from below.

name: Hungry Archive
description: A library of forbidden books that eats memories and shelves them for later.

powers.name: Page Turn
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Targets forget their last action.

powers.name: Quiet Please
powers.text: No damage. Nobody can speak or cast until a player wins a Charm test.

tactics: Fights from the shelves. Burning books hurts it but releases what it ate.

name: Void Reaper Drone
description: A black, silent warship drone that hunts crippled ships and finishes them off.

powers.name: Lance Barrage
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Hull Breach
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Opens the target's hull to space.

tactics: Picks off crippled targets first. Hide in debris.

name: Four-Armed Cyborg General
description: A coughing cyborg warlord who wields four laser blades, collects trophies and commands a droid army.

powers.name: Blade Whirl
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Call the Army
powers.text: No damage. Adds a fresh group of droids to the fight.

tactics: Hides behind droids until the party gets close. Wounds make him cough and run.

name: Probe Drone
description: A floating, one-eyed scout droid that drops from the sky, scans everything and calls in the fleet.

powers.name: Call Reinforcements
powers.text: No damage. A group of troopers shows up two turns later.

tactics: Scans, reports, then flees. Destroy it before it sends its signal.

name: Chrome Assassin
description: A tall, thin silver droid that has been programmed with a long list of targets.

powers.name: Perfect Shot
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Has one target and ignores the rest. Stops when the target is gone or the droid is destroyed.

name: Rolling Shield Droid
description: A droid that rolls into battle as a wheel, then unfolds with a bubble shield and twin cannons.

powers.name: Bubble Shield
powers.text: No damage. Blocks every ranged attack until it moves.

tactics: Rolls in, unfolds and plants itself. Melee attackers get around the shield.

name: Scrap Crawler
description: A rolling junk fortress the size of a house that collects droids and scrap from the desert.

powers.name: Tractor Hook
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Pulls a target inside until they escape.

tactics: Moves slowly toward the largest pile of scrap. Climb on top to find the hatch.

name: Moon Fortress
description: A moon-sized battle station with a planet-cracking laser, a dark emperor and one very small weak spot.

powers.name: Planet Cracker
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Destroys everything in the area.

powers.name: Tractor Beam
powers.text: No damage. Holds a ship or a party in place until the beam is cut.

tactics: A battle station, not a monster: the players win by finding the shaft and blowing the reactor.

name: Neon Karaoke Bot
description: A glowing street-corner robot that will sing every hit song of the last century, whether you want it or not.

powers.name: Power Ballad
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Hit targets must dance and have disadvantage until the song ends.

tactics: Stays on the stage and sings. Cut its power cable or boo it off the stage.

name: Cherub Skull Swarm
description: A cloud of tiny winged skulls with halos that sing hymns and shoot lasers.

powers.name: Hymn Barrage
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Flies in a flock and sings. Break the leading skull and the rest scatter.

name: Clockwork Carousel
description: A huge gear-driven carousel that rolls through towns playing music and grabbing riders.

powers.name: Wild Ride
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Hit targets are carried around and must win Physique to get off.

powers.name: Calliope Waltz
powers.text: No damage. Everyone in earshot must dance until the music stops.

powers.name: Brass Ring
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Rolls toward the biggest crowd. Stop the main gear to stop the ride.

name: Gingerbread Colossus
description: A house-sized cookie giant with gumdrop buttons, icing trim and an unquenchable urge to hug you.

powers.name: Gumdrop Barrage
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Sticky. Hit targets have disadvantage to move.

powers.name: Candy Cane Slam
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Regrow Icing
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by licking its own icing.

tactics: Chases the smallest player. Dunk it in milk and it falls apart.

name: Roving Convoy City
description: A city on wheels built from a hundred trucks, towing its streets, markets and a warlord's tower across the dust.

powers.name: Cannon Wall
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense.

powers.name: Boarding Gangs
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Drivers and raiders swarm the targets.

powers.name: Fuel Run
powers.text: No damage. Adds a fresh convoy of vehicles each turn.

tactics: Rolls forward and cannot turn quickly. Lure it into a trap or take out the lead truck.

name: Battle Barge Cathedral
description: A cathedral-shaped warship the size of a mountain, with a thousand guns and a thousand prayers.

powers.name: Lance Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Orbital Bombardment
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Razes buildings.

powers.name: Boarding Pods
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Drops marines into the fight.

tactics: Hangs in orbit and hammers one target. Board it and cut the reactor to stop it.

name: Chrome Scarab Swarm
description: A hissing cloud of palm-sized metal beetles that strips armor and flesh from anything it covers.

powers.name: Armor Strip
powers.text: No damage. A hit target loses its armor bonus until it rests.

tactics: Swarms the best-armored target. Fire and area attacks scatter it.

name: Tomb Lord
description: A crowned, skeletal metal lord who wakes in a dead world and has not forgotten a single grudge.

powers.name: Phase Back
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 as its body repairs itself.

powers.name: Staff Blast
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Commands tomb warriors from behind. Teleports away when badly hurt.

name: Tomb Monolith
description: A huge floating black obelisk with a green glowing doorway that spits out an endless line of tomb warriors.

powers.name: Portal Ranks
powers.text: No damage. Brings in a fresh squad of tomb warriors each turn.

powers.name: Eternity Gate
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Hit targets are flung away.

tactics: Hovers over the battlefield and calls in troops. Close the gate by destroying its power core.

name: Spirit-Stone Walker
description: A towering, graceful construct of bone-colored crystal animated by the soul of a dead space elf.

powers.name: Soul Wail
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hit targets are afraid (disadvantage) until they rest.

tactics: Walks slowly and fights like a mourner. A soul gem in the chest controls it.

name: Sky Coalition Battlesuit
description: A tall, sleek, white-and-orange battle exo-suit with a pilot, a jetpack and a lot of guns.

powers.name: Jet Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Jumps and fires from the air.

tactics: Hits and jumps away. Close combat is its weakness.

name: Entombed Veteran
description: A wounded old hero sealed alive in a walking war machine with an arm cannon and a power fist.

powers.name: Last Stand
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Wake the Ancient
powers.text: No damage. Gains advantage on every attack for one turn.

tactics: Fights until the pilot dies. A talk with the old hero can reveal old memories.

name: Penitent Engine
description: A walking war machine with a penitent soul strapped inside, flaming flails and a mad scream.

powers.name: Flail Frenzy
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Hits every target in reach.

tactics: Charges in a straight line and keeps swinging. Hard to stop; easy to dodge.

name: Throne Knight
description: A tall, noble war walker piloted by a house lord, with a thermal cannon on one arm and a reaper chain-sword on the other.

powers.name: Thermal Cannon
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Walker's Stomp
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Hit targets are knocked prone.

tactics: Strides in with a banner and a challenge. Honor-bound and easy to bait.
